Connector contract test suite

Source: R/connector_contract_tests.R
ConnectorContract.Rd

A suite of contract cases grouped by connector method. Create one with connector_contract_tests(), which describes the default cases and how to run them.

Method run()

Run every case as its own testthat::test_that(), named "connector contract: <method>() <case>".

Usage

ConnectorContract$run(
  new_connector,
  reporter = if (testthat::is_testing()) {
     NULL
 } else {

    testthat::ProgressReporter$new(show_praise = FALSE)
 }
)

Arguments

new_connector

function(env) returning a new, empty connector. Any cleanup must be tied to env, e.g. with withr::local_tempdir(.local_envir = env), so it runs when each test ends.

reporter

NULL to report to the active testthat reporter, as in a package's test files. Or a testthat::Reporter to report the cases on their own. Defaults to NULL inside a testthat run and to a progress reporter that prints a summary outside one, e.g. in the console.

Returns

The suite, invisibly.
